# Overview

This report evaluates probe-level quality for the 477-gene Xenium panel by comparing
each gene's expression behavior against a matched scRNA-seq reference (16,000 cells,
16 cell types). Probes with aberrant cross-platform behavior are flagged as WARN or FAIL,
and cell type marker coverage is assessed to identify annotation risks for SingleR.

**Approach**:

1. Gene-gene Spearman correlation matrices → per-gene correlation-of-correlations (rho)
2. Top-20 partner Jaccard overlap
3. Per-gene summary statistics (mean, variance, detection rate, overdispersion)
4. Multi-criteria flagging (PASS / WARN / FAIL)
5. Cell type coverage analysis against canonical markers

---

# 1. Load data

```{r load-libraries}
source("scripts/00_setup.R")
library(zellkonverter)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
```

## 1a. Load Xenium SFEs and combine counts

```{r load-xenium, cache=TRUE}
sfe_names <- c(
 "sfe_tma",
 "sfe_WT01", "sfe_WT02", "sfe_WT03",
 "sfe_WT04", "sfe_WT05", "sfe_WT06",
 "sfe_WT07", "sfe_WT08"
)

mat_list   <- list()
sample_vec <- character(0)

for (nm in sfe_names) {
  message("Loading ", nm, " ...")
  sfe <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment(dir = file.path(sfe_dir, nm))
  m   <- assay(sfe, "counts")
  mat_list[[nm]] <- m
  # Build sample ID vector for stratified downsampling
  sid <- rep(nm, ncol(m))
  sample_vec <- c(sample_vec, sid)
  rm(sfe); gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# Combine into single sparse matrix (genes × cells)
xen_full <- do.call(cbind, mat_list)
rm(mat_list); gc(verbose = FALSE)

message("Full Xenium matrix: ", nrow(xen_full), " genes x ",
        format(ncol(xen_full), big.mark = ","), " cells")
```

## 1b. Downsample Xenium to ~200K cells

Stratified by sample to preserve composition. 200K cells is sufficient for
stable Spearman gene-gene correlation estimates while keeping the dense matrix
under 1 GB.

```{r downsample-xenium}
set.seed(42)
target_n <- 200000

# Stratified sampling: proportional to sample size
sample_tab <- table(sample_vec)
sample_frac <- target_n / sum(sample_tab)
keep_idx <- integer(0)

for (s in names(sample_tab)) {
  idx <- which(sample_vec == s)
  n_keep <- max(1, round(length(idx) * sample_frac))
  keep_idx <- c(keep_idx, sample(idx, min(n_keep, length(idx))))
}

xen_ds <- xen_full[, keep_idx]
rm(xen_full); gc(verbose = FALSE)

message("Downsampled Xenium: ", nrow(xen_ds), " genes x ",
        format(ncol(xen_ds), big.mark = ","), " cells")
```

## 1c. Load scRNA-seq reference

```{r load-scrna, cache=TRUE}
sce <- readH5AD("data/xenium_celltype_downsampled.h5ad", reader = "R")
message("scRNA-seq: ", nrow(sce), " genes x ", ncol(sce), " cells")
message("Cell types: ", paste(sort(unique(sce$xenium_celltype)), collapse = ", "))
```

## 1d. Intersect gene sets and prepare matrices

```{r prepare-matrices}
common_genes <- sort(intersect(rownames(xen_ds), rownames(sce)))
n_common <- length(common_genes)
n_xen_only <- length(setdiff(rownames(xen_ds), rownames(sce)))
xen_only_genes <- setdiff(rownames(xen_ds), rownames(sce))

message("Common genes: ", n_common, " / ", nrow(xen_ds), " panel genes")
message("Xenium-only (no scRNA match): ", n_xen_only)
if (n_xen_only > 0) {
  message("  Missing from scRNA: ", paste(xen_only_genes, collapse = ", "))
}

# Subset and apply log1p (matching user's previous approach)
scrna_mat <- as.matrix(assay(sce[common_genes, ], "counts"))
xen_mat   <- as.matrix(xen_ds[common_genes, ])

scrna_mat <- log1p(scrna_mat)
xen_mat   <- log1p(xen_mat)

rm(xen_ds, sce); gc(verbose = FALSE)
message("Prepared: ", n_common, " genes, log1p-transformed")
```

---

# 2. Gene-gene correlation analysis

## 2a. Compute Spearman correlation matrices

```{r gene-gene-cor, cache=TRUE}
message("Computing scRNA gene-gene Spearman correlation (", n_common, " x ", n_common, ") ...")
sc_cor <- cor(t(scrna_mat), method = "spearman")

message("Computing Xenium gene-gene Spearman correlation ...")
xe_cor <- cor(t(xen_mat), method = "spearman")

# Remove self-correlations
diag(sc_cor) <- NA
diag(xe_cor) <- NA
message("Done.")
```

## 2b. Correlation-of-correlations (rho) and Jaccard overlap

```{r corr-of-corr}
# Per-gene: Spearman correlation between gene's co-expression profile in each platform
rho <- diag(cor(sc_cor, xe_cor, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

# Top-k partner Jaccard overlap
topk_jaccard <- function(A, B, k = 20) {
  G <- ncol(A)
  out <- numeric(G)
  for (i in seq_len(G)) {
    ai <- A[, i]; ai[i] <- -Inf
    bi <- B[, i]; bi[i] <- -Inf
    ka <- head(order(ai, decreasing = TRUE), k)
    kb <- head(order(bi, decreasing = TRUE), k)
    out[i] <- length(intersect(ka, kb)) / length(union(ka, kb))
  }
  out
}

jac <- topk_jaccard(sc_cor, xe_cor, k = 20)

probe_qc <- data.frame(
  gene              = common_genes,
  rho_corr_of_corr  = rho,
  top20_jaccard     = jac,
  stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
)
rm(sc_cor, xe_cor); gc(verbose = FALSE)
```

---

# 3. Per-gene summary statistics

```{r per-gene-stats}
row_var <- function(mat) {
  m    <- rowMeans(mat)
  sq_m <- rowMeans(mat^2)
  sq_m - m^2
}

detect_rate <- function(mat) {
  rowMeans(mat > 0)
}

mean_nonzero <- function(mat) {
  apply(mat, 1, function(x) if (any(x > 0)) mean(x[x > 0]) else 0)
}

sc_mean  <- rowMeans(scrna_mat)
xe_mean  <- rowMeans(xen_mat)
sc_var   <- row_var(scrna_mat)
xe_var   <- row_var(xen_mat)
sc_det   <- detect_rate(scrna_mat)
xe_det   <- detect_rate(xen_mat)
sc_mnnz  <- mean_nonzero(scrna_mat)
xe_mnnz  <- mean_nonzero(xen_mat)
sc_overd <- sc_var / pmax(sc_mean, .Machine$double.eps)
xe_overd <- xe_var / pmax(xe_mean, .Machine$double.eps)

gene_qc <- data.frame(
  gene             = rownames(scrna_mat),
  sc_mean          = sc_mean,
  xe_mean          = xe_mean,
  log2_mean_ratio  = log2((xe_mean + 1e-8) / (sc_mean + 1e-8)),
  sc_var           = sc_var,
  xe_var           = xe_var,
  var_ratio        = (xe_var + 1e-8) / (sc_var + 1e-8),
  sc_detect_rate   = sc_det,
  xe_detect_rate   = xe_det,
  detect_rate_diff = xe_det - sc_det,
  sc_mean_nonzero  = sc_mnnz,
  xe_mean_nonzero  = xe_mnnz,
  mean_nonzero_diff = xe_mnnz - sc_mnnz,
  sc_overdisp      = sc_overd,
  xe_overdisp      = xe_overd,
  overdisp_ratio   = (xe_overd + 1e-8) / (sc_overd + 1e-8),
  row.names        = NULL,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

## 3a. Merge with correlation metrics

```{r merge-qc}
probe_qc_full <- merge(gene_qc, probe_qc, by = "gene", all.x = TRUE)
probe_qc_full <- probe_qc_full[order(-probe_qc_full$rho_corr_of_corr), ]
```

---

# 4. Multi-criteria flagging

```{r flagging}
## Threshold rationale (data-driven, relaxed for targeted panel)
#
# Original thresholds were calibrated for full-transcriptome comparisons.
# A 477-gene panel has truncated co-expression space (low Jaccard is expected)
# and systematic cross-platform mean/detection shifts (in-situ vs dissociated).
#
# Relaxed thresholds target ~5-15% of genes per flag:
#   rho < 0.3         — bottom 5% (co-expression severely disrupted)
#   jaccard < 0.05    — bottom 5% (essentially no partner overlap)
#   |log2mr| > 2.5    — >5.7-fold shift (only extreme distortion)
#   var_ratio 1/5–5   — 5-fold variance change
#   |detect_diff| > 0.30 — 30pp detection shift
#   |mnnz_diff| > 0.75  — large non-zero expression distortion
#   overdisp 0.5–2    — kept (already catches only 5.7%)

flag_qc <- probe_qc_full %>%
  mutate(
    flag_corr    = rho_corr_of_corr < 0.3 | top20_jaccard < 0.05,
    flag_mean    = abs(log2_mean_ratio) > 2.5,
    flag_var     = var_ratio < 0.2 | var_ratio > 5,
    flag_detect  = abs(detect_rate_diff) > 0.30,
    flag_nonzero = abs(mean_nonzero_diff) > 0.75,
    flag_overdisp = overdisp_ratio < 0.5 | overdisp_ratio > 2,
    n_flags      = rowSums(across(starts_with("flag_"))),
    qc_flag      = case_when(
      n_flags >= 3 ~ "FAIL",
      n_flags == 2 ~ "WARN",
      TRUE         ~ "PASS"
    )
  )

flag_qc$qc_flag <- factor(flag_qc$qc_flag, levels = c("PASS", "WARN", "FAIL"))

# Summary
flag_tab <- table(flag_qc$qc_flag)
message("Flag summary: ", paste(names(flag_tab), flag_tab, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
```

---

# 8. Cell type coverage analysis

Marker gene assignments are derived from the panel design spreadsheet
(`data/Updated Xenium_2024_10.xlsx`), which maps 140 genes to 12 level1 cell types
and 30 level2 subtypes based on the `considered_for` column. This is far more
comprehensive than the 83-gene cellassign set.

```{r celltype-coverage}
# Load comprehensive panel marker mapping (built from Excel panel design)
panel_markers <- read.csv("metadata/panel_markers.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Annotate each marker gene with its probe QC status
panel_markers$probe_qc <- NA_character_
for (i in seq_len(nrow(panel_markers))) {
  g <- panel_markers$gene[i]
  if (g %in% flag_qc$gene) {
    panel_markers$probe_qc[i] <- as.character(flag_qc$qc_flag[flag_qc$gene == g])
  } else if (g %in% rownames(xen_mat)) {
    # In panel but gene name doesn't match scRNA reference
    panel_markers$probe_qc[i] <- "NO_REF"
  } else {
    # In panel design but not in filtered SFE (shouldn't happen)
    panel_markers$probe_qc[i] <- "NOT_IN_DATA"
  }
}

# --- Level 1 coverage ---
l1_markers <- panel_markers %>% filter(level == "level1")
l1_types <- sort(unique(l1_markers$cell_type))

coverage_list <- list()
for (ct in l1_types) {
  ct_genes <- l1_markers$gene[l1_markers$cell_type == ct]
  n_total  <- length(ct_genes)
  qc_status <- l1_markers$probe_qc[l1_markers$cell_type == ct]
  pass_qc  <- sum(qc_status == "PASS", na.rm = TRUE)
  warn_qc  <- sum(qc_status == "WARN", na.rm = TRUE)
  fail_qc  <- sum(qc_status == "FAIL", na.rm = TRUE)
  no_ref   <- sum(qc_status == "NO_REF", na.rm = TRUE)
  reliable <- pass_qc + warn_qc + no_ref

  risk <- dplyr::case_when(
    reliable < 3  ~ "HIGH RISK",
    reliable <= 5 ~ "MODERATE",
    TRUE          ~ "OK"
  )

  gene_str <- paste(ct_genes, collapse = ", ")

  coverage_list[[ct]] <- data.frame(
    cell_type  = ct, n_markers = n_total,
    pass = pass_qc, warn = warn_qc, fail = fail_qc, no_ref = no_ref,
    reliable = reliable, risk = risk, genes = gene_str,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

coverage_df <- do.call(rbind, coverage_list)
coverage_df <- coverage_df[order(coverage_df$reliable), ]
rownames(coverage_df) <- NULL
```

---

# 11. Gene exclusion decisions for SingleR {.tabset}

This section applies a **4-tier decision framework** to determine which genes to exclude
from the SingleR reference before cell type annotation. The framework balances probe quality
(from QC metrics) against marker importance (cell type coverage risk).

**Why exclude at all?** SingleR computes Spearman correlations between each query cell's
expression profile and reference cell type centroids. A gene with fundamentally different
behavior between platforms (e.g., anti-correlated co-expression) will actively mislead
classification — worse than simply not having the gene.

**Tier definitions**:

| Tier | Label | Criterion | Action |
|------|-------|-----------|--------|
| 1 | **HARD EXCLUDE** | rho < 0.2 AND ≥3 flags | Remove — co-expression anti-correlated/random |
| 2a | **EXCLUDE** | ≥3 flags, not a marker | Remove — no annotation value |
| 2b | **EXCLUDE** | ≥3 flags, marker but type has ≥5 reliable markers | Remove — redundant marker |
| 2c | **KEEP WITH CAUTION** | ≥3 flags, marker for type with <5 reliable markers | Keep — critical for at-risk cell type |
| 3 | **INCLUDE (monitor)** | 2 flags (WARN) | Keep — monitor in validation |
| 4 | **INCLUDE** | ≤1 flag (PASS) or Xenium-only | Keep — no concerns |

```{r exclusion-decisions}
# --- Build gene exclusion decisions ---

# Level 1 marker-to-cell-type mapping with coverage info
l1_marker_coverage <- panel_markers %>%
  filter(level == "level1") %>%
  left_join(coverage_df %>% select(cell_type, reliable, risk), by = "cell_type")

# Per-gene: summarise across all cell types a gene marks for
gene_marker_summary <- l1_marker_coverage %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    marker_for    = paste(sort(unique(cell_type)), collapse = ", "),
    min_reliable  = min(reliable, na.rm = TRUE),
    worst_risk    = case_when(
      any(risk == "HIGH RISK") ~ "HIGH RISK",
      any(risk == "MODERATE")  ~ "MODERATE",
      TRUE                     ~ "OK"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join marker info onto flag_qc
gene_decisions <- flag_qc %>%
  select(gene, qc_flag, n_flags, rho_corr_of_corr, top20_jaccard) %>%
  left_join(gene_marker_summary, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    is_marker    = !is.na(marker_for),
    min_reliable = ifelse(is.na(min_reliable), NA_real_, min_reliable),
    worst_risk   = ifelse(is.na(worst_risk), NA_character_, worst_risk)
  )

# Apply 4-tier decision tree
gene_decisions <- gene_decisions %>%
  mutate(
    tier = case_when(
      # Tier 1: Hard exclude — co-expression anti-correlated or random
      rho_corr_of_corr < 0.2 & n_flags >= 3 ~ "HARD_EXCLUDE",
      # Tier 2a: FAIL, not a marker
      n_flags >= 3 & !is_marker              ~ "EXCLUDE",
      # Tier 2b: FAIL marker but type is well-covered
      n_flags >= 3 & is_marker & min_reliable >= 5 ~ "EXCLUDE",
      # Tier 2c: FAIL marker critical for at-risk type
      n_flags >= 3 & is_marker & min_reliable < 5  ~ "KEEP_CAUTION",
      # Tier 3: WARN
      n_flags == 2                           ~ "INCLUDE_MONITOR",
      # Tier 4: PASS
      TRUE                                   ~ "INCLUDE"
    ),
    decision = case_when(
      tier %in% c("HARD_EXCLUDE", "EXCLUDE") ~ "Exclude from SingleR",
      tier == "KEEP_CAUTION"   ~ "Include (monitor closely)",
      tier == "INCLUDE_MONITOR" ~ "Include (monitor)",
      tier == "INCLUDE"        ~ "Include"
    ),
    reason = case_when(
      tier == "HARD_EXCLUDE" ~
        paste0("rho = ", round(rho_corr_of_corr, 2),
               "; co-expression anti-correlated or random"),
      tier == "EXCLUDE" & !is_marker ~
        paste0("FAIL (", n_flags, " flags); not a cell type marker"),
      tier == "EXCLUDE" & is_marker ~
        paste0("FAIL (", n_flags, " flags); marker for ", marker_for,
               " but type has ", min_reliable, " reliable markers"),
      tier == "KEEP_CAUTION" ~
        paste0("FAIL (", n_flags, " flags) but critical for ", marker_for,
               " (", worst_risk, ", only ", min_reliable, " reliable markers)"),
      tier == "INCLUDE_MONITOR" ~
        paste0("WARN (", n_flags, " flags); borderline metrics"),
      tier == "INCLUDE" ~ "PASS"
    )
  )

# Add Xenium-only genes
if (n_xen_only > 0) {
  xen_only_marker_info <- data.frame(gene = xen_only_genes,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(gene_marker_summary, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      qc_flag          = "XENIUM_ONLY",
      n_flags          = NA_integer_,
      rho_corr_of_corr = NA_real_,
      top20_jaccard    = NA_real_,
      is_marker        = !is.na(marker_for),
      tier             = "INCLUDE",
      decision         = "Include",
      reason           = ifelse(
        is_marker,
        paste0("Xenium-only; marker for ", marker_for,
               " (not in scRNA ref — SingleR ignores automatically)"),
        "Xenium-only gene (SingleR ignores automatically)"
      )
    )

  gene_decisions <- bind_rows(gene_decisions, xen_only_marker_info)
}

# Sort by tier severity
tier_order <- c("HARD_EXCLUDE", "EXCLUDE", "KEEP_CAUTION",
                "INCLUDE_MONITOR", "INCLUDE")
gene_decisions$tier <- factor(gene_decisions$tier, levels = tier_order)
```

# 13. Save outputs

```{r save-outputs}
out_probe <- file.path(out_dir, "05_probe_qc")
if (!dir.exists(out_probe)) dir.create(out_probe, recursive = TRUE)

# Full probe QC metrics
data.table::fwrite(probe_qc_full, file.path(out_probe, "probe_qc_full.csv"))
message("Saved: ", file.path(out_probe, "probe_qc_full.csv"))

# Flagged QC table
data.table::fwrite(flag_qc, file.path(out_probe, "flag_qc.csv"))
message("Saved: ", file.path(out_probe, "flag_qc.csv"))

# Gene exclusion decisions (all genes with tier, decision, reason)
data.table::fwrite(gene_decisions, file.path(out_probe, "gene_exclusion_decisions.csv"))
message("Saved: ", file.path(out_probe, "gene_exclusion_decisions.csv"))

# Exclusion list for SingleR (one gene per line)
exclude_genes <- gene_decisions$gene[gene_decisions$tier %in% c("HARD_EXCLUDE", "EXCLUDE")]
writeLines(sort(exclude_genes), file.path(out_probe, "genes_exclude_singler.txt"))
message("Saved: ", file.path(out_probe, "genes_exclude_singler.txt"),
        " (", length(exclude_genes), " genes)")

# Monitor list for SingleR validation (one gene per line)
monitor_genes <- gene_decisions$gene[gene_decisions$tier %in%
                                       c("KEEP_CAUTION", "INCLUDE_MONITOR")]
writeLines(sort(monitor_genes), file.path(out_probe, "genes_monitor_singler.txt"))
message("Saved: ", file.path(out_probe, "genes_monitor_singler.txt"),
        " (", length(monitor_genes), " genes)")
```
